subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: Must this WeChat multi-account hot-reload fix include redacted live A+B QR-login proof before merge, or is the focused gateway lifecycle regression suite an acceptable waiver?
rationale: Only a gateway owner can calibrate whether the provider-specific runtime evidence is required; the contributor cannot obtain an approved real WeChat session from the current automation environment.

options.title: Require live provider proof
options.body: Attach redacted logs or a recording showing account A remains online after account B’s QR login triggers the account-index reload.

options.title: Waive live proof explicitly
options.body: Accept the focused lifecycle regression coverage, type checking, build evidence, and green CI as sufficient for this narrowly scoped handoff fix.

recommendation.title: Require live provider proof
recommendation.body: Attach redacted logs or a recording showing account A remains online after account B’s QR login triggers the account-index reload.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline routes the gateway review to joshavant, and the unresolved blocker is gateway proof policy rather than a mechanical code repair.
